title: Website-wide polish pass and refactor to remove duplicate code

requirements.text: Polish UI/UX across all existing pages so they feel consistent and seamless: align typography scale, spacing, page headings, section layout, and empty/loading/error states across Landing, Browse, Listing Detail, Listing Form, My Tools, Requests, My Rentals, Rental Detail, Messaging, Profile, and Community Map pages.

quotes: please take the whole website now and polish up each page and get rid of duplicate functions and make things more seamless

acceptanceCriteria: Every route defined in frontend/src/App.tsx has a consistent page header pattern (title + optional subtitle) and consistent top/bottom padding.
All pages that load data show a consistent loading UI (same component/pattern) and a consistent empty state (card/panel styling, aligned CTA button styles).
Common UI elements (badges, cards, buttons, alerts) look visually consistent across pages in both light and dark mode.

requirements.text: Introduce shared frontend utilities/components to eliminate duplicated logic and mappings currently repeated across pages/components (e.g., rental status label/color mapping and date formatting). Replace page-local implementations with shared imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Rental status labels and badge classes are defined in a single shared module and reused wherever RentalStatus is rendered (no duplicated status maps in page files).
Common date formatting used for rentals is defined in a single shared utility and reused by rental-related pages/components.
After refactor, pages previously containing inline duplicates (e.g., MyRentalsPage) no longer define their own status label/color maps or ad-hoc date formatting helpers.

requirements.text: Remove dead/duplicate frontend code and placeholders, and ensure the codebase has no unused exports/imports related to removed files. In particular, address the empty placeholder hook file frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts by either removing it or implementing it and consolidating map zoom behavior into a single, clearly-named hook without duplication.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts is no longer an empty placeholder; the project builds cleanly with no references to missing/removed symbols.
Map zoom/pan interaction logic lives in one hook (no overlapping/duplicated implementations across hooks).
TypeScript build passes without unused import/export warnings introduced by the cleanup.

requirements.text: Make cross-page interactions feel seamless by standardizing navigation and action patterns: consistent primary/secondary CTAs, consistent link styling, and predictable placement of key actions (e.g., “Add Tool”, “View Details”, “Manage Rentals/Requests”) across relevant pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary actions use a consistent button variant and placement pattern across pages (e.g., top-right header action on management pages like My Tools).
Secondary actions (links and outline/ghost buttons) follow a consistent hierarchy and styling across pages.
No page contains conflicting navigation patterns for similar tasks (e.g., “View Tool”, “View Details”)—labels and components are consistent.

requirements.text: Apply a single coherent visual theme across the app (colors, typography, surface styles, radii, shadows) and enforce it consistently using existing Tailwind + shadcn primitives; keep the theme neutral and modern (avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette).
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is visible across all pages (same surface/background treatment, consistent typography scale, consistent card and input styling).
Theme works well in both light and dark mode using the existing theme variables setup.
No new product features are introduced as part of the visual refresh—only styling and consistency improvements.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
Do not edit any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend migration code if state schema must change (avoid schema changes for this polish/refactor request).
nonGoals: Adding new product features or new routes not already present in frontend/src/App.tsx.
Changing backend data models or introducing new persistent state purely for UI polish.
Integrating third-party services (analytics, auth providers beyond Internet Identity, etc.).
